Leave an internal note on a conversation. Notes are not messages: they
are never sent to the contact and are only included in the AI's context
when marked AiVisible.
Delete an internal note. Only the note's author may delete it.
Update an internal note's body and/or AI visibility.

List a lead's scheduled messages: everything pending, plus recent
failures so they stay visible in the conversation.

Schedule a message to a lead for a future time — either a manually
typed message or one generated at send time by the conversation's
last-responding AI agent.

Cancel a pending scheduled message, or dismiss a failed one. Creator
or team members only. The row is kept (status "canceled") for
auditability; a dismissed failure keeps its original StatusReason.

Update a pending scheduled message's time, body (manual only), or
cancel-on-reply flag. Creator or team members only.
Send a message to a lead

Broadcast human typing state to live subscribers for a lead.

The metrics a board can be ranked by. Clients should build their columns from this rather
